The[?] Cunard steamship Scotia, Captain Judkins, which
sailed[?] from Liverpool on the 14th, at ten A. M., and
from[?] Queenstown on the evening of the 15th of July,
arrived at this port about ten o'clock last night.
The[?] news is three days later than the advices[?] by the
City[?] of Paris.
